issuerId.title: Issuer ID
issuerId.description: Registry-wide unique key for this issuing authority, e.g. ISS-FARMER.

name.title: Issuer name
name.description: Displayed to staff in the portal and used as the credential's display issuer.

did.title: Issuer DID
did.description: The did:web this authority signs with. Recorded for display and audit only — the signing DID actually used is the `author` of the bound credential schema, so that a schema and its signer can never disagree.

credentialConfigId.title: Credential configuration ID
credentialConfigId.description: OID4VCI credential_configuration_id this issuer issues. Discovered from credential-schema; empty means the issuer exists but cannot issue yet.

credentialName.title: Credential name
credentialName.description: Display name of the bound credential type. Denormalised so the issuer list renders without a call per issuer; re-read from credential-schema whenever the binding changes.

holderLabel.title: Holder label
holderLabel.description: What this issuer calls the people it issues to — Farmer, Citizen, Student. Drives every noun in the portal's holder screens.

holderIdPrefix.title: Holder ID prefix
holderIdPrefix.description: Prefix for generated holder IDs, e.g. FRM gives FRM-000101. Kept short and upper-case.

recordEntities.title: Supporting record types
recordEntities.description: Comma-separated registry entities holding this issuer's supporting records, e.g. `LandParcel,Crop,SeedDistribution`. The portal renders one tab per entry, so an issuer whose credential needs no supporting records leaves this empty.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Image shown as this authority's logo. May be a path served by the portal (/issuer-portal/logos/x.svg) or an absolute http(s) URL. The emoji `icon` is the fallback when this is empty or the image fails to load.

url.title: Website
url.description: The authority's public homepage, linked from its card. http(s) only — any other scheme is refused when rendering, since this string reaches an anchor href.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: A single emoji, used when no logo URL is set or the logo cannot be loaded.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: Hex colour used for this issuer's card and header, so staff can tell at a glance which issuer they are working in.

status.title: Status
status.description: Draft issuers are listed but cannot issue — used while a credential schema is still being prepared.
